We searched Scopus and Web of Science (exports imported DATE) with a Boolean query, developed against 1 known-relevant development paper. Validation set hidden until the query is frozen or the uploads are marked final. The searches returned 43 records; deduplication by DOI, exact title and corroborated fuzzy title matching left 40 unique records. Records were ranked by their similarity to one anchor sentence per construct cell (anchors version 1, mean of the top 1 cells) using the embedding model fake. A band-stratified probability sample of 12 records across the ranking and a purposive development set of 7 records were labelled by 1 reviewer. Each development sample record needed one reviewer's final label. Titles and abstracts were screened by fake against a codebook of 2 elements; every grade had to be supported by a verbatim quote, and a record was excluded only when the construct was shown to be absent or the study unrelated. Two independent reads with a blind third read on disagreement were combined by a 2-of-3 majority (protocol main): 13 records were included and 1 kept for full-text reading, of 40 screened. Every pass (pass A, pass B and the judge) used fake. Passes A, B and the judge use the same model (fake, temperature 0): their readings are not independent. Recall on validation is revealed once every sampled record has a final label. Not yet: 11 of 12 records have no label. Nothing was estimated or recorded. The procedure, prompts, run specifications and all numbers are reproducible from the project with WIDER (protocol hash ae3d231b66e9).
